tools.description: Report native backend, capabilities and app state.
tools.name: rocknroll_status

tools.description: List active, favorite, recent, calendar and outcome meetings.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor copied verbatim from a previous response's next_cursor. Reusing a cursor with changed filters fails with CURSOR_EXPIRED.

from.description: RFC 3339 lower time bound; a time-zone offset or Z is required. When both bounds are given, from must be earlier than to.

kind.description: Restrict results to one meeting kind.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; values outside 1...100 are rejected. Defaults to 20.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter over titles and summaries; the value is trimmed and a whitespace-only filter is ignored.

to.description: RFC 3339 exclusive upper time bound; a time-zone offset or Z is required.

tools.name: rocknroll_list_meetings

meeting_id.description: Opaque meeting identifier: the id of an item returned by rocknroll_list_meetings or rocknroll_search — never a meeting title.

tools.description: Get the authoritative transcript available to the native meeting.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor copied verbatim from a previous response's next_cursor. Reusing a cursor with changed filters fails with CURSOR_EXPIRED.

from.description: RFC 3339 lower time bound; a time-zone offset or Z is required. When both bounds are given, from must be earlier than to.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; values outside 1...100 are rejected. Defaults to 20.

meeting_id.description: Opaque meeting identifier: the id of an item returned by rocknroll_list_meetings or rocknroll_search — never a meeting title. Must identify an active session (id starts with session:).

to.description: RFC 3339 exclusive upper time bound; a time-zone offset or Z is required.

tools.name: rocknroll_get_transcript

tools.description: Get one stored historical outcome by outcome ID. Task items include the current profile’s archived flag.

outcome_id.description: Opaque outcome identifier: the id of a kind:outcome item from rocknroll_list_meetings or rocknroll_search, or the meeting_id field of task items. This is not a meeting_id.

tools.name: rocknroll_get_outcome

tools.description: Get the raw Markdown note for one meeting by a persisted or active session ID. Notes are user-authored personal records; they are attributed separately from outcomes and transcripts. Never a write: this tool changes nothing.

meeting_id.description: Opaque meeting identifier: an id returned by rocknroll_list_meetings or rocknroll_search. Must identify a persisted session (id starts with session:) or an outcome-backed historical session.

tools.name: rocknroll_get_notes

tools.description: List tasks from native meeting outcomes. Tasks archived by the current profile are excluded by default.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor copied verbatim from a previous response's next_cursor. Reusing a cursor with changed filters fails with CURSOR_EXPIRED.

include_archived.description: Include tasks archived by the current profile; defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; values outside 1...100 are rejected. Defaults to 20.

meeting_id.description: Filter by outcome id (outcome:…), matching the meeting_id field of task items.

owner.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the task owner.

personal_only.description: Only tasks assigned to the current profile by stable ID or confirmed full alias.

tools.name: rocknroll_list_tasks

tools.description: Search native meetings, outcomes, tasks and transcripts.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor copied verbatim from a previous response's next_cursor. Reusing a cursor with changed filters fails with CURSOR_EXPIRED.

include_archived.description: Include task results archived by the current profile; defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; values outside 1...100 are rejected. Defaults to 20.

personal_only.description: Restrict task results to the current profile's assignments.

query.description: Case-insensitive search text, trimmed; must be non-empty after trimming.

types.description: Result types to search; defaults to all five. Unknown values are rejected.

tools.name: rocknroll_search

tools.description: Read allowlisted native settings and resolved attention configuration.

meeting_id.description: Active session id; only consulted when sections includes meeting.

sections.description: Settings sections to include. Defaults to all three.

tools.name: rocknroll_get_settings

tools.description: Request a bound native meeting control. Every call requires native approval; a session target applies device state or leaves, a room or calendar target joins it.

action_id.description: Client-generated UUID used as an idempotency key. Retrying with the same action_id and identical arguments replays the recorded result; reusing it with different arguments fails with ACTION_ID_REUSED.

desired_state.description: Requested device state; an empty object is allowed. Joining (room:/occurrence: targets) uses microphone=false to join muted; leave and camera apply to active sessions only.

camera.description: Desired camera state for a session.

microphone.description: Desired microphone state for a session; for a join target, false joins muted.

meeting_id.description: Opaque meeting identifier: the id of an item returned by rocknroll_list_meetings or rocknroll_search — never a meeting title.

tools.name: rocknroll_control_meeting

tools.description: Set a favorite room through the native library. expected_revision is required unless action_id replays a recorded call; the current value is published as sections.app.favorite_revision by rocknroll_get_settings.

action_id.description: Client-generated UUID used as an idempotency key. Retrying with the same action_id and identical arguments replays the recorded result; reusing it with different arguments fails with ACTION_ID_REUSED.

expected_revision.description: Opaque revision of the target observed before the call. Required unless this action_id replays an already-recorded call; see the tool description for where the current value is published.

favorite.description: true stars the room, false unstars it.

room_id.description: Opaque room identifier: the id of a favorite or recent item from rocknroll_list_meetings.

tools.name: rocknroll_set_favorite

tools.description: Update an allowlisted task field. expected_revision is the outcome UUID (the middle component of task_id) and is required unless action_id replays a recorded call. An empty patch applies no changes.

action_id.description: Client-generated UUID used as an idempotency key. Retrying with the same action_id and identical arguments replays the recorded result; reusing it with different arguments fails with ACTION_ID_REUSED.

done.description: New completion state; omit to leave unchanged.

expected_revision.description: Opaque revision of the target observed before the call. Required unless this action_id replays an already-recorded call; see the tool description for where the current value is published.

owner.description: New owner; omit to leave unchanged.

task_id.description: Opaque task identifier: the id of a task item from rocknroll_list_tasks, rocknroll_search or rocknroll_get_outcome.

text.description: New task text; omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: rocknroll_update_task

tools.description: Update an allowlisted native setting. expected_revision is the revision field from rocknroll_get_settings and is required unless action_id replays a recorded call.

action_id.description: Client-generated UUID used as an idempotency key. Retrying with the same action_id and identical arguments replays the recorded result; reusing it with different arguments fails with ACTION_ID_REUSED.

expected_revision.description: Opaque revision of the target observed before the call. Required unless this action_id replays an already-recorded call; see the tool description for where the current value is published.

sections.description: Settings patch; omitting it applies no changes. Unknown section or field names are rejected.

multiple_meetings.description: Allow joining more than one meeting at once.

attention.description: Attention settings; every field is a boolean.

draft_replies.description: Draft replies to messages directed at you.

generate_outcomes.description: Summarize meetings into outcomes with tasks.

pause_on_battery.description: Pause attention work while on battery power.

push_to_talk.description: Hold a key to talk back to a meeting.

remote_outcomes.description: Request outcomes from the remote meeting service.

tools.name: rocknroll_update_settings

tools.description: Run a safe in-app assistant prompt. Actions that need native confirmation are returned as approval-required and are never executed through MCP.

action_id.description: Client-generated UUID used as an idempotency key. Retrying with the same action_id and identical arguments replays the recorded result; reusing it with different arguments fails with ACTION_ID_REUSED.

conversation_id.description: Recognized for compatibility but always rejected with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: this assistant exposes no external conversation IDs.

meeting_id.description: Optional active session id (starts with session:) scoping the assistant to one meeting.

prompt.description: Assistant instruction, trimmed; must be non-empty after trimming.

tools.name: rocknroll_run_assistant
